input.summary: Express the 90-day warranty period numerically and scope the warranty refund to all amounts paid for the non-conforming item, not just the narrowly defined "Fees".
input.comment: [Playbook] The warranty standards, duration and remedy ladder in Section 19 work for us, but "Fees" is defined in Section 1.5 as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, so the refund limb of Section 19.4 would return implementation charges alone and never the subscription fees paid for non-conforming Hosted Services or Deliverables. We have keyed the refund to all amounts paid for the affected item and stated the ninety (90) day period in numerals for clarity; our playbook requires repair, replacement or a real refund remedy.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later,
ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later,

ops.oldText: Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it.
ops.newText: Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of all amounts paid for it, including prepaid subscription and other charges and not limited to the Implementation Fee.
